summary: Clarified final-regression no-command skip predicate and added skipped_by_project_policy proof contract.

items.title: No-command skip predicate is underspecified
items.rationale: The spec now limits skipped_by_project_policy to true absence of supported command sources and keeps malformed configured commands or invalid discovery states as invalid_project_test failures.
items.evidence: spec.json constraints[], requirements[R5].desc, acceptance_criteria[], clarifications[], and tasks[T-4] now state the predicate and failure boundary.

items.title: Skipped artifact proof contract is missing
items.rationale: The spec now requires a skipped_by_project_policy proof object with command-discovery evidence instead of exempting the new skip kind from proof validation.
items.evidence: spec.json overview.decisions[], acceptance_criteria[], clarifications[], tasks[T-1].acceptance, and tasks[T-4].acceptance define proof.kind and proof.commandDiscovery fields.
